verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LiteLLM itself being configured or administered through natural-language commands, such as an NL assistant in the admin UI or an agent interface that manages keys, budgets or routing. The completion() interface forwards natural-language prompts to downstream LLMs, and the MCP Gateway proxies other MCP tools to agents. Both are adjacent capabilities, not natural-language operation of the product, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
